verdict.rationale: ADK is code-first, so agent logic, tools and orchestration are defined in code. It also ships its own REST API server (`adk api_server`) with a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec and Swagger UI, alongside CLI commands for run, eval and deploy that mirror the dev web UI's test, evaluate and debug roles. However, no evidence states that the REST API matches the web UI feature for feature, and the Go server lacks the /docs endpoint. Missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity statement or mapping, documentation of the running server's own /openapi.json, and independent or hands-on confirmation that every web UI action is reachable programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the API server in ADK to expose your agents through a REST API for programmatic testing
ADK publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document (info title "ADK REST API Reference") for the ADK API server
Code-First Development: Define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for ultimate flexibility, testability, and versioning.
A built-in development UI to help you test, evaluate, debug, and showcase your agent(s).
